text: In the year eight ninety seven, Pope Stephen the Sixth put his dead predecessor on trial for real.
asr: In the year 897, Pope Stephen VI put his dead predecessor on trial for real.

text: Nine months after Pope Formosus died, guards dug up his corpse and dressed the skeleton in gold robes.
asr: Nine months after Pope Formosus died, guards dug up his corpse and dressed the skeleton in gold robes.

text: They propped him on a throne and appointed a trembling young deacon to answer as his defence lawyer.
asr: They propped him on a throne and appointed a trembling young deacon to answer as his defence lawyer.

text: The silent skeleton still lost the case, had his three blessing fingers chopped off, and was stripped of his title.
asr: The silent skeleton still lost the case, had his three blessing fingers chopped off, and was stripped of his title.

text: After his body was tossed into the Tiber River, Rome rebelled and banned putting dead people on trial forever.
asr: After his body was tossed into the Tiber River, Rome rebelled and banned putting dead people on trial forever.
